title: ownCloud

short_desc.pt: A sua própria nuvem de arquivos.

description.en: File sync and sharing on a cloud of your own
description.pt: Sincronização e compartilhamento de arquivos em nuvem própria

author: owncloud
notes: With [Collabora](../collabora) running, `.docx`, `.xlsx` and `.odt` open in the
browser instead of only downloading. Enable the app once:
podman exec owncloud occ app:enable richdocuments
podman exec owncloud occ config:app:set richdocuments wopi_url \
The `wopi_url` is where your browser loads the editor from, so it is the
tailnet address and not a container name.
